ex: The main factory closed down; [hence] the sudden rise in local unemployment.
The mountain road was coated in thick ice, and [hence] unsafe to drive on.
She forgot her keys inside; [hence], she had to call a locksmith to enter.

defn: in spite of; despite
ex: [Notwithstanding] the heavy torrential rain, the championship game continued as scheduled.
She finished the 42-kilometer marathon, [notwithstanding] a sharp knee pain.
[Notwithstanding] his total lack of work experience, he was hired right away.

defn: although; even though
ex: The patient is making steady progress, [albeit] very slowly.

defn: it is possible to imagine or believe; plausibly
ex: With modern gene technology, scientists could [conceivably] eradicate the disease within ten years.
If sea levels rise rapidly, coastal cities could [conceivably] end up underwater.
The construction delays could [conceivably] double the project's original budget.
